source.title: MafB-restricted local monocyte proliferation precedes lung interstitial macrophage differentiation
source.license_evidence: Official article Rights and permissions section; no panel-specific third-party attribution in the inspected figure.

selection: Every nonblank value from worksheet 3c: Lung Control B:F and IM-DTR G:L; Serum Control N:U and IM-DTR V:AC; rows 3–6, with source hours A/M and all 20 blanks recorded. No source observation is selected out.
preparation: CSV numeric strings equal the original XLSX XML values verbatim; actual cell addresses retained. Descriptive means and SEM independently recomputed from every source value; no renormalization.

origin.change: rectangular crop and raster rendering only; no figure marks/colors changed

reference.role: Observable visual mechanisms for Create design; not the required layout. The published Days label is corrected from explicit hours in the caption and workbook.

semantic_limits: Terminal mouse sampling supports cross-sectional time groups; absent mouse/batch IDs forbid cross-time or cross-compartment pairing.
Separate lung pg/mg protein and serum pg/ml axes; cross-panel absolute heights cannot be compared.
Eight supplied adjusted P values retained separately, not plotted or independently recomputed; cross-compartment correction family scope is not supplied.
Raw x is a bounded categorical physical offset; original hours and display offsets are both recorded. Exact source hours anchor means/SEM.
One literature-informed real-data case; no model-wide or CNS-level efficacy claim.
